reviews.rationale: All three claims (C032, C033, C034) are supported by a single source (Ref 15). The citation traces confirm that the trial (NCT02308228) exists and has published results. Every specific p-value mentioned in the claims (p=0.003, p<0.001, p=0.005, p=0.020, and p=0.007) was successfully located within the source abstract. There are no missing citations for direct claims and no numeric inconsistencies.

The claims are highly calibrated and strictly limited to the reported statistical outcomes of a specific trial (NCT02308228). The submission avoids the common pitfall of extrapolating these findings to a general population or claiming a broad 'muscle-wasting' effect of metformin; instead, it reports the specific metrics (lean body mass, thigh muscle area, and fiber percentage) and their associated p-values as found in the source data. There is no mechanism inflation or over-claiming present.

The submission is exceptionally precise and well-supported. The Evidence Auditor confirmed that every p-value and metric cited in claims C032, C033, and C034 matches the source data from trial NCT02308228. The Domain Skeptic correctly noted that the author avoided over-generalization, restricting the claims to the specific outcomes of the referenced study rather than making broad clinical assertions about metformin's effect on muscle mass.

Since both the Auditor and the Skeptic are in full agreement and the citation traces show a 100% match for all numerical data, there is no dissent to weigh. The evidence is direct, verified, and presented without inflation.
